title: ProductsContent
description: Products content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of products, each with a picture, a name as a link and the price as it is shown. One object is valid in every products layout (three or four columns, rows).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.description: the products, in the order they are shown

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.description: address of the product picture; none: the placeholder

title.description: the name of the product (the alt text of the picture)

price.description: the price as it is shown

href.description: the address of the product; none: the name is plain text
